headline: "Foreigners Are Back"…Is This a Signal of a KOSPI Trend Reversal?
summary: The KOSPI closed at 6598.26 on the 5th, up 3.76% from the previous session. Foreign investors moved into large net purchases during the rally.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock index, and foreign investor flows are closely watched as a signal of demand for Korean equities.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index closed up 3.76% on the 5th, after a near-5% intraday surge, with foreign investors buying heavily.
